events.summary: Deep subagent research validates the Homeostatic Awareness Loop as the right approach, with two added gates before implementation: retrieval/compression gating before attend/context injection, and trust/provenance gating before durable memory promotion. Biology supports replay/consolidation/forgetting as heuristics; AI-agent evidence supports feedback-grounded reflection; ML retrieval evidence warns against top-k dumping; product prior art says the wedge is repo-scoped operational awareness, not generic memory DB or Jira.
